defects.what: The 100 customers are declared a teaching set only on the brand plate ('TEACHING SET · SEEDS 7 · 90') and the page; the captions present them as 'your' retention data ('100 customers. 30 chose the feature; 24 of them stayed')
During the coin-flip reshuffle the 100 squares scatter into a jumble for a few seconds; the frame reads as a glitch before they settle into 50/50
The commit frame is a bare 0-to-30 bar with 'NONE OF IT / ALL OF IT'; functional, but the weakest frame of the film

one_line: The HRT reversal is the right real case and the same hundred counted twice, as they chose and by coin flip, is the cleanest statement of selection in the batch; ship it.
